svg.metadata: Target and surrounding national geometry: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural vectors, WGS84, public domain, via LonnyGomes/CountryGeoJSONCollection commit 5120290da88f3f205f74aa55f3c8fa1f19d1bc8b (MAR/SAH/DZA/ESP/PRT/MRT GeoJSON). Morocco target uses the existing MAR source geometry; Western Sahara is rendered separately as geographic context.
